words.prose: {{ar:بِأَنَّ}} ({{tr:biʾanna}}) opens the ayah as an explanation, not as a new independent event. The particle reaches back to the earth's reporting in 99:4 and turns the whole following clause, {{ar:رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا}} ({{tr:rabbaka awḥā lahā}}), into the reason that report can occur. Because the unit combines causal bi- with assertive {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:ʾanna}}), the cause is presented as an established fact-clause: the reader first hears the earth report, then the grammar pulls that report under prior divine communication. The instrumental shade is useful only inside that causal frame; the revealed communication explains the report and is the means by which it becomes possible.

topics.headline: effect is read before its cause

topics.reason: The fused particle launches the ayah in dependency and places the full Lord-waḥy-recipient frame under one compact explanatory unit.

words.prose: {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}) names the subject inside the asserted cause-clause, so the earth's speech is traced to the Lord who authorizes it. The construct form with the attached -ka makes that authority relational: the cosmic scene briefly passes through direct address before returning to the earth as recipient. The {{ar:ر ب ب}} ({{tr:r-b-b}}) pressure of ownership, mastery, nurture, and governance matters here because the one who commands the earth is also the one whose lordship has governed its capacity for testimony. Across the boundary, the prior owned reports become governed testimony rather than self-originating speech. The following {{ar:أَوْحَىٰ}} ({{tr:awḥā}}) keeps the stable title from becoming static; Lordship is immediately expressed as the authority-to-message pairing expected of the divine source. The doubled bāʾ gives the title a compact, held center before the clause releases into the revelation predicate.

topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}) as the accusative subject of {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:ʾanna}}), and attachment evidence makes the following verb phrase its predicate.

topics.reason: The suffix is definitely second-person masculine singular and construct-bound, but attachment evidence names only a single addressee role; rows that specify the Prophet as the only resolution are narrowed to direct address without forced antecedent resolution.

words.prose: {{ar:أَوْحَىٰ}} ({{tr:awḥā}}) is the decisive predicate of the cause-clause: after the particle opens the explanation and {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}) names the source, this verb supplies the act that makes the earth's testimony possible. Its Form IV shape presents waḥy as something caused to reach the recipient, with the initial hamza making the derived causative stem visible before the lām phrase names where that communication lands. Its perfect form makes that authorization already accomplished before the earth's ongoing reporting in 99:4. The construction does not name an overt message object; instead, {{ar:لَهَا}} ({{tr:lahā}}) is the visible complement, so the focus falls on directed reception. The lām frame narrows the wide {{ar:و ح ي}} ({{tr:w-ḥ-y}}) field toward concealed, instilled communication to a non-rational created recipient, in line with the bees and heavens pattern (16:68; 41:12), rather than ordinary prophetic address. Even the cadence of {{ar:أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا}} ({{tr:awḥā lahā}}) helps bind the act and recipient as one closing unit, while the ḥā gives the recitation a narrowed breath-channel before the open ending.

topics.reason: The local verb governs {{ar:لَهَا}} ({{tr:lahā}}), and the supplied CRITICAL rows give concrete parallels with bees (16:68) and heavens (41:12); this supports a lām-recipient formula without replacing the local parse.

topics.headline: perfect form makes authorization complete

topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:أَوْحَىٰ}} ({{tr:awḥā}}) as a perfect verb, while the comparison to the imperfect reporting verb in 99:4 is a valid local contrast.

topics.headline: object omission foregrounds reception

topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the local frame as having no overt direct object and warns against supplying a content object; claims of unlimited semantic openness are narrowed to the actual omission.

topics.headline: root pressure keeps waḥy concealed and swift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the earth's report as the outward result of prior hidden and swift communication, while the lām frame keeps the local sense recipient-directed.
topics.reason: V4 supports hidden conveying, signal, message, writing, low utterance, and quickness for {{ar:و ح ي}} ({{tr:w-ḥ-y}}), but local Form IV with lām selects concealed directed communication rather than all branches converging equally.

topics.reason: The local predicate assigns {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}) as source and {{ar:هَا}} ({{tr:hā}}) as recipient through the lām phrase, matching the communication-channel rows.

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la-}}) is small, but it decides how the waḥy lands. Attached to {{ar:هَا}} ({{tr:hā}}), it makes the earth the marked recipient of {{ar:أَوْحَىٰ}} ({{tr:awḥā}}), so the clause turns from the act of revealing toward the entity addressed by a fitting mode of communication. That lām choice differs from the usual prophetic-address ilā frame and makes the earth's reception part of a non-rational created-recipient mode. Since no direct content object is visible, the lām phrase carries the complement weight at the end of the ayah. Its directional force is primary, while the benefactive or special-designation shade can remain as a local nuance: the communication is to the earth and fitted for its role, not merely information floating near it.

topics.headline: lām directs waḥy to the earth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition turns waḥy into recipient-directed communication suited to the earth.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la-}}) as the preposition governing the pronoun recipient after {{ar:أَوْحَىٰ}} ({{tr:awḥā}}).

topics.headline: lām differs from the prophetic-address frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the particle choice as part of the communication mode, with earth treated like a created recipient rather than a human prophetic addressee.
topics.reason: The local preposition is lām, and the supplied CRITICAL pattern contrasts it with the more common {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) frame for prophetic reception.

topics.headline: direction carries fitted-for nuance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the waḥy is not only aimed at the earth but fitted to the earth's role in disclosure.
topics.reason: The local frame licenses recipient direction. Benefactive and special-designation values are kept as nuance, not as a replacement for the syntactically forced recipient relation.

topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the verb with no overt content object and the lām-governed pronoun as the recipient complement.

words.prose: {{ar:هَا}} ({{tr:hā}}) carries the earth into the final position of the ayah. The feminine suffix resumes {{ar:ٱلْأَرْض}} ({{tr:al-arḍ}}) from 99:2 and links this recipient to the same earth that owns reports in {{ar:أَخْبَارَهَا}} ({{tr:akhbārahā}}) in 99:4. Because the pronoun is attached to the lām, the clause closes as {{ar:لَهَا}} ({{tr:lahā}}): not a repeated noun, but a compact recipient complement. Ending on the pronoun makes the explanation land on the earth's reception of waḥy, so the causal loop is tight: the earth reports because the same earth has been made recipient of divine communication.

topics.headline: feminine suffix resumes the earth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader identifies the recipient of waḥy as the same earth already active in the surah, not as an unnamed feminine object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly licenses the feminine suffix in {{ar:لَهَا}} ({{tr:lahā}}) as resuming the earth.

topics.headline: same suffix sustains earth as participant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the same feminine suffix from earth as report-holder to earth as waḥy-recipient, so testimony and reception belong to one participant.
topics.reason: The supplied pronoun chain links the earth in 99:2, the suffix in {{ar:أَخْبَارَهَا}} ({{tr:akhbārahā}}) in 99:4, and the suffix in {{ar:لَهَا}} ({{tr:lahā}}) in 99:5.

topics.headline: attached pronoun keeps the complement compact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earth is not renamed; it is folded into the prepositional complement as an attached recipient suffix.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:هَا}} ({{tr:hā}}) as an attached pronoun, and attachment evidence makes it the object of the lām preposition.

topics.headline: ayah closes on the recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the causal explanation complete only when the recipient is named at the end.
topics.reason: The word is the final pronoun of the clause and completes the lām-governed recipient complement after the waḥy verb.

topics.headline: open cadence seals the final phrase

topics.reason: The phrase repeats the open ending across verb and prepositional pronoun phrase; the payoff is recitational closure, not a separate grammatical claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا joins the Lord-title to a directed act of divine communication toward a feminine recipient.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship supplies ownership and governing authority, while divine wahy supplies an authorized message or subjection; together they make the recipient's response commissioned service rather than autonomous initiative.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the sender as the recipient's governing master and ground the commission.
Divine message, inspiration, and subjection supply the authoritative communication that puts the recipient into service.

changed_reading.before: The verse says only that the Lord communicated something to a feminine recipient.
changed_reading.after: The recipient is authoritatively commissioned by its possessor-governor, so what follows from the communication is an act under command.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَبَّكَ and أَوْحَىٰ can be read together as governance by forming and inwardly informing the addressed recipient.
baseline_models.mechanism: The nurturing and completing branch of rabb combines with hidden impartation in wahy: rule operates by preparing the recipient stage by stage and placing the knowledge or capacity needed for its task within it.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, administration, and completion make lordship a formative process that equips the recipient.
Hidden imparting of knowledge supplies the inward transfer by which the recipient becomes able to perform its assigned function.

changed_reading.before: Wahy is a message delivered to an already capable recipient.
changed_reading.after: The Lord's wahy also capacitates the recipient, inwardly furnishing the knowledge and readiness by which its function reaches completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb أَوْحَىٰ with the dative لَهَا permits a material communication model in which content is placed into, rather than merely spoken at, the feminine recipient.
baseline_models.mechanism: The writing and stone-secret branches construe wahy as durable encoding: a message can remain latent in its recipient like an inscription that is simultaneously hidden and recoverable.

activation_trace.role: Writing and inscription supply the image of communication encoded materially into the recipient.
A secret or plain incision in stone supplies the dual possibility of a durable record that is latent yet later legible.

changed_reading.before: The recipient receives an ephemeral utterance.
changed_reading.after: The recipient may be imagined as bearing a durable, initially latent encoding whose contents can later become manifest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context resolves the feminine recipient as the earth and supplies repeated bodily upheaval. Read through gestural wahy, the quake becomes a possible nonverbal uptake of sovereign direction: the commanded body communicates by moving.

activation_trace.role: Governing lordship supplies the authority under which the earth's motion can function as execution.
Gesture and indication supply a nonverbal communication channel whose functional realization can be bodily movement.
Repeated disturbance and shaking supply the earth's conspicuous bodily action and make it the enactment candidate.
The lower realm opposite the sky identifies the material body to which the feminine pronoun and the motion belong.

structural_cues: 99:1 repeats the quake root as verb and cognate noun around the named earth, while 99:5's feminine لَهَا points back to that agent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earth, intensified shaking, sovereign authority, and gestural communication; I supply the arrow from received cue to bodily execution. A live alternative is that the quake precedes and occasions the later instruction rather than enacting it.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified feminine recipient receives a private divine message.
changed_reading.after: The earth receives a sovereign cue that may be legible in its own movement, making the quake an embodied communication-act as well as an event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth brings concealed, weighty contents outward. Combined with inscription and the stone-secret image of wahy, this turns the focus verse into the authorization that unseals a material archive and releases what it had carried.

activation_trace.role: The secret or incision in stone supplies the image of an earth-held record that can pass from concealment to legibility.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earth, hidden-to-outward emergence, consequential weight, and stone-like inscription; I infer storage followed by commanded release. Literal bodies, treasures, or other burdens remain live alternatives to a record-archive.

changed_reading.before: The Lord gives the earth a message that later makes it speak.
changed_reading.after: The Lord authorizes the earth to unseal what has been durably lodged within it, so revelation functions as archive release as well as speech-command.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human voices a question after sensory encounter, whereas the earth is made to understand by hidden indication. The focus verse therefore marks an epistemic asymmetry: the nonhuman recipient is privately instructed while the human observer remains publicly perplexed.

activation_trace.role: Hidden imparting supplies the earth's privileged, nonpublic access to the directive or knowledge.

Producing speech by articulation supplies the overt human channel that contrasts with hidden wahy.

structural_cues: The human's مَا لَهَا in 99:3 and the Lord's أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا in 99:5 repeat the same dative pronoun while reversing who understands the earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overt human utterance, sensory recognition, and covert divine indication; I infer a deliberate contrast between communication channels. The clauses may instead simply narrate successive acts without ranking their knowers.

changed_reading.before: Wahy identifies only how the Lord communicates with the earth.
changed_reading.after: Wahy also distinguishes the earth's immediate hidden receptivity from the human's delayed, sensory, and verbally perplexed response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Freshly produced discourse and knowledge of an affair's interior convert hidden impartation into public testimony. The focus verse is the causal relay-joint: sovereign wahy either gives the earth its reportable knowledge, authorizes its utterance, or does both.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority supply the warrant under which the recipient's testimony becomes official rather than self-originating.

structural_cues: The causal بِأَنَّ at the opening of 99:5 explicitly grounds 99:4's earth-reporting in the Lord's wahy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a causal link, hidden knowledge-transfer, renewed reporting, and knowledge of interior matters; I infer a two-stage private-to-public relay. The live alternative is that wahy authorizes speech while the earth's knowledge comes from what it independently bore.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's communication is one event beside the earth's report.
changed_reading.after: The verse is the causal hinge that converts inwardly held knowledge into authorized public testimony, joining source, witness, and report.

context_deltas.mechanism: Issuing forth, population, separation, compelled display, and deeds form an ordered workflow. Read through formative administration and divine subjection, the focus verse commissions the earth as an initiating station in a process that releases people into differentiated disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Administration and stagewise completion supply the process-governance frame for the downstream sequence.

Manifest humanity supplies the population moving through the commissioned process.
Dispersal and separation supply the sorting operation between release and display.
Causing something to be seen supplies the workflow's disclosure endpoint.
Intentional deeds supply the payload presented at the disclosure endpoint.

structural_cues: 99:6 sequences issuing, being scattered, and a purpose clause of being shown deeds, giving the context a release-sort-display order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies administration, divine subjection, departure, population, separation, display, and deeds; I infer that the command to earth initiates this workflow. A live alternative is that 99:6 describes a later divine ordering in which earth has no administrative role beyond prior testimony.

changed_reading.before: The command concerns only the earth's ability to narrate.
changed_reading.after: The command may commission the earth as the first operational station in a governed release, sorting, and disclosure of persons and deeds.

context_deltas.mechanism: Purposeful action, exact weight, minute dispersion, opposed moral values, and compelled visibility specify a fine-grained and polarity-complete accounting system. The earth's wahy can thus be read as an exact disclosure protocol that preserves and returns even the smallest distributed trace.

activation_trace.role: Completion and administration supply the requirement that the disclosure process reach exhaustive, ordered fulfillment.
Writing and inscription supply a record-like mechanism capable of preserving itemized traces.
Purposive action supplies the kind of item entered into and retrieved from the accounting process.
The measure and weight image supplies calibration and exact comparability rather than vague recollection.
Smallness joined to dispersal supplies the difficult minimum case that the protocol must still preserve and retrieve.
Beneficial good supplies one moral polarity whose traces must be shown without loss.
Causing to see supplies observable retrieval as the endpoint of the record process.
Evil and harm supply the opposite moral polarity and make the disclosure protocol symmetrical rather than selective.

structural_cues: 99:7 and 99:8 are nearly exact syntactic mirrors, changing good to evil while repeating action, measure, minute unit, and seeing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies record-like wahy, administrative completion, measured minuteness, moral symmetry, and visible retrieval; I infer that these specify the earth's commission. Weighing and showing could instead occur after and independently of the earth's reporting.

changed_reading.before: The earth receives a general instruction to disclose what it knows.
changed_reading.after: The earth receives something like a precision disclosure protocol: retain, distinguish, and return every trace, however minute or dispersed, across both moral polarities.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ر ب و mapping for focus ر ب ب and the quickness branch of wahy, so neither should replace the ordinary syntax. It remains anchored in both focus roots and gains material support from shaking and fertile earth; downstream prose should present it only as a cross-branch analogy of sudden maturation or raising.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split mapping under رَبَّكَ and the verb أَوْحَىٰ permit an exploratory interaction between raising or growth and rapid activation.

activation_trace.role: Increase and rising supply a non-dominant vertical-growth image for the Lord-title's effect on the recipient.
Nurture and growing up supply maturation as the process that the command rapidly brings to its terminal stage.
Quickness and haste supply the sudden acceleration by which gradual growth is recast as abrupt upheaval.
Violent shaking supplies the observable abruptness and bodily transformation associated with the rapid raising.
Soft fertile earth supplies the growth-bearing material whose latent contents can be forced into sudden emergence.

changed_reading.before: The Lord commands a completed earth to begin an assigned act.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the command rapidly matures and raises the earth into its final disclosure-state, compressing gradual nurture into sudden upheaval.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because mourning is a remote branch of wahy in this verbal setting, so it cannot serve as a direct gloss. It remains anchored in أَوْحَىٰ and is activated by the earth's release of burdens and renewed report; downstream prose should qualify it as an affective overtone of testimony, not a claim that the verse literally says the earth mourns.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb أَوْحَىٰ has a packet branch of crying and mourning that can color, without replacing, the earth-directed communication.

activation_trace.role: Crying and mourning supply the affective possibility that the commissioned voice is lament as well as information.
Bringing hidden contents outward supplies the release around which an earth-lament could be voiced.
Heavy burdens supply the affective weight that makes lament a coherent overlay rather than an isolated branch association.
Newly produced report-speech supplies the actual vocal outlet through which the affective overlay could surface.

changed_reading.before: The earth neutrally reports facts because it has been instructed.
changed_reading.after: With careful qualification, the commanded testimony can carry the overtone of a lament released together with the earth's burdens.

strongest_changes: The causal link between 99:4 and 99:5 turns wahy into a hidden-to-public relay that authorizes and possibly supplies the earth's testimony.
The earth's expulsion of concealed weight activates the inscription branches of wahy, changing the recipient into an archive that is commanded to unseal itself.
The mirrored minimum-weight clauses recast the command as a precise, polarity-complete disclosure protocol rather than a generic inspiration.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah is a compact causal hinge: lordship supplies authority and formative administration, while wahy can simultaneously name command, covert knowledge-transfer, nonverbal indication, and durable encoding. Context turns those latent senses into an earth-body that moves, stores, reports, releases, sorts, and exposes.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not decide whether wahy gives the earth report-content, merely authorizes speech, or capacitates both knowledge and utterance.
The quake may enact the command, precede it, or simply identify the recipient; the causal direction from wahy to movement is reader-supplied.
Archive language is strongly activated but remains a material model, while rapid raising and lament are deliberately contained branch-distant outliers.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Earth’s speech as authorized hidden instruction.** Lexical evidence: `ر ب ب B001` lordship/ownership/authority; `و ح ي B001` hidden imparting of knowledge; `و ح ي B004` divine message/inspiration. Structural cue: 99:5 gives the reason for 99:4’s earth-report: it reports because your Lord conveyed to it. Assigned role: `ربك` supplies authority/ownership; `أوحى لها` supplies the covert instruction that activates the earth’s testimony. Abductive move: the packet gives a causal `بأن`; I infer that the earth’s report is not autonomous speech but authorized witness-performance. Reading change: the scene shifts from earth as marvel to earth as obedient recipient of a divine communicative act.

2. **Nurture/completion behind judgment.** Lexical evidence: `ر ب ب B002` repair, nurture, and completion; activated by the basmalah’s `ر ح م B001/B003` mercy/womb and 99:2’s `ث ق ل B007` pregnancy becoming heavy. Structural cue: the possessive `ربك` appears at the hinge where violent disclosure becomes intelligible testimony. Assigned role: lordship is not only sovereignty but stage-by-stage bringing to completion, including the completion of hidden deeds into visible outcomes. Abductive move: I infer that the same authority that nurtures a process also brings its concealed result to term. Reading change: the ayah makes judgment look like completion/maturation, not only command.

3. **Inscription-in-earth reading.** Lexical evidence: `و ح ي B003` writing/inscription and `و ح ي B010` inscription or secret in stone; activated by `ء ر ض B001` ground and `خ ب ر B001` inner knowledge. Structural cue: the earth’s reports follow a divine `وحي` directed to her, while later deeds are shown. Assigned role: the earth is like a surface in which secrets have been inscribed and are now readable. Abductive move: I supply that hidden acts leave inscription-like traces in the ground/world; the packet gives inscription/secret, earth, report, and seeing. Reading change: the ayah reads as the unsealing of a divine archive written into material reality.

4. **Low sound/gesture rather than ordinary speech.** Lexical evidence: `و ح ي B002` gesture/indication; `و ح ي B005` low or hidden sound; activated by `ق و ل B001` human utterance in 99:3 and `ح د ث B003` earth’s speech in 99:4. Structural cue: human speech is explicit and bewildered; divine communication to earth is covert and effective. Assigned role: revelation to earth can be nonverbal or sub-verbal yet sufficient to produce full report. Abductive move: I infer asymmetry between divine-to-earth communication and human speech: the former may be a sign/low impulse, the latter articulated question. Reading change: `أوحى لها` becomes more material and immediate than a “message” alone: a covert activation, signal, or command.

5. **Swift activation.** Lexical evidence: `و ح ي B006` quickness/haste; activated by the rapid chain from `إذا` to `يومئذ` and the sudden خروج/تحديث sequence. Structural cue: the surah’s clauses move with compressed event-sequence and little descriptive delay. Assigned role: `أوحى` can color the transition from silent earth to speaking earth as immediate. Abductive move: I supply temporal compression from the branch’s speed image to the syntax’s quick succession. Reading change: the ayah reads as the instant enabling of testimony, not a slow briefing.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 99:6-8 made `أوحى لها` look like the hinge between cosmic witness and personal display: the revelation to earth is not the final disclosure but the command that routes people toward seeing their own works. The later measuring of deeds also sharpened `ر ب ب B002`: lordship completes processes by bringing hidden deposits to their finished, visible measure.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A hidden commission causes public disclosure.** Fixed `و ح ي/B001` supplies covert imparting of knowledge and `B004` a divine message; the causal `بِأَنَّ` links that imparting to the earth's report in 99:4. Later, 99:6-8 move from report to deeds being shown and seen (`ر ء ي/B012`, `B001`). The fixed revelation's role is both causal and authorizing: it gives the earth knowledge and licenses its testimony. The packet states the causal link to speech, but the extension from speech to the later visual display is inferred. `أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا` therefore governs a covert-to-public evidentiary chain.

2. **The earth can be read exploratorily as an inscribed archive.** Fixed `و ح ي/B003` supplies writing and inscription, while `B010` supplies a secret or plainly incised message in stone. The recipient is the earth (`لَهَا`), whose own reports precede the showing of possessed deeds (`أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ`). Those features assign the inscription branches a storage role: acts become a legible terrestrial record. The packet never explicitly says that deeds were written into earth, so inscription-as-recording is the abductive step. On this reading the revelation is not only a momentary command to speak but the protocol by which earth can retain and expose a record.

3. **Lordship administers a staged completion through apparent destruction.** Fixed `ر ب ب/B001` supplies ownership and obeyed authority; `B002` supplies repairing, administering, nurturing, and completing something stage by stage. The surah's sequence moves through shaking, extraction, report, human departure, display, and exact seeing. The fixed `رَبَّكَ` takes the role of process governor holding those stages together. The inference is that the disruptive stages serve completion rather than constituting uncontrolled collapse. "Your Lord" consequently reads as the one who brings earth and human action to their completed disclosure, not only the issuer of a single command.

4. **Material upheaval becomes a mode of indication before speech.** Fixed `و ح ي/B002` supplies gesture, hint, or indication that makes an addressee understand without direct statement. The earth first shakes and expels; only afterward does 99:4 name its report. The gesture branch assigns those earlier material acts a nonverbal communicative role. The claim that they enact the divine indication is inferred, since the packet explicitly attaches revelation only as the cause of reporting. This lets `أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا` encompass an embodied sequence of signs as well as propositional speech.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 99:6-8 showed that the commission does not terminate in speech: it proceeds to the showing of deeds and to direct individual sight. This retrospectively strengthened `و ح ي/B003` and `B010` as an exploratory inscription/archive mechanism, because the communicated earth-record proves displayable at exact scale. The same later completion also sharpened `ر ب ب/B002`: staged administration, rather than a one-off command, best accounts for the full sequence.

findings.text: Gizli ilahî iletim, yeryüzünün herkese açık tanıklığını başlatan bilgi ve yetkilendirme kaynağı olur.
Yeryüzü, eylemlerin üzerine işlendiği ve zamanı gelince okunabilir hâle gelen bir arşiv gibi de düşünülebilir.
Rablik, sarsıntıdan tek tek görmeye uzanan yıkıcı görünen aşamaları yönetip gizli işleri tamamlanmış bir açığa çıkışa ulaştırır.
Yere iletilen vahiy, açık bir sözden çok, önce maddi hareketi başlatan sözsüz veya gizli bir işaret boyutu kazanır.
İletimin hız boyutu, sessiz yerin tanıklığa geçişini gecikmesiz bir etkinleşme olarak gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, Tanrı bilgisiyle donanmış, dinî hükümleri bilen, bilgeliği olan ve başkalarını temel bilgilerden başlayarak yetiştiren bilgin tipini ortak bir kimlikte birleştirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan tanıklanan bilgin ve öğretici kişi anlamıyla sınırlıdır; başka yapılardan anlam aktarılmaz.

facets.statement: Kişi Tanrı bilgisiyle ve dinî konulardaki sağlam bilgisiyle tanımlanır.
Bilgiyi yalnız taşımakla kalmaz, başkalarını küçük adımlarla öğretip yetiştirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar Tanrı'yı bilme, dinî hükümleri kavrama, bilgelik ve aşamalı öğreticilik özelliklerini aynı bilgin kişide bir araya getirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dinî bilgi, bilgelik ve öğretici yetiştiricilik özelliklerinin birlikte vurgulandığı kişi için uygundur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin dinî uzmanlığı ile insan yetiştirme görevini birlikte anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dinî uzmanlık ve öğretici yetiştirme görevini birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Tanrı bilgisine sahip bilgin ve öğretici

error_profile.preserves: Bilgi sahibi olma yönünü genel olarak korur.
error_profile.loses: Tanrı bilgisi, dinî sınır ve insanları aşama aşama yetiştirme görevini kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tanrı bilgisi ve insanları temel bilgilerden başlayarak yetiştirme görevi odak dalda belirleyicidir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرباني والربانيون بمعنى العلماء والحكماء وأهل العلم بالرب أو من يرب العلم ونفسه به

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, çok sayıdaki insanın bir topluluk oluşturması ve ayrı kabilelerin tek bir birlik hâlinde toplanması çekirdeğini destekler. Sayı değeri ve belirli kabile birliği bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan tanıklanan büyük insan topluluğu ve birleşmiş kabileler alanında kalır; hayvan sürüsü anlamı bu dala genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Çok sayıda insanın bir araya gelmesiyle oluşan büyük topluluk ya da ayrı kabilelerin ortak bir birlik hâlinde birleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, insanların büyük sayıda bir araya gelerek topluluk oluşturmasıdır.
On bin kişilik topluluk ve beş kabilenin tek birlik olması tanıklanan özel örneklerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar binlerce kişilik toplulukları, on bin kişilik bir sayıyı ve birleşmiş kabileleri büyük sayı ile toplanma ortaklığında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çok sayıda insanın ya da birleşmiş kabilelerin oluşturduğu topluluğu genel olarak anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: İnsanlardan oluşma, büyüklük ve bir araya gelme çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ayrı kabilelerin tek bir ortak birlik oluşturduğu tarihsel topluluk bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kabilelerin toplanıp tek birlik oluşturması yönünü korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da insanların bir araya gelmesiyle oluşan topluluğu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal büyük sayı ile kabile birliğini öne çıkarır; komşu dal ise sayı veya kabile koşulu olmadan her türlü toplanmış grubu kapsar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الربة والجماعات الكثيرة، والربيون إذا فسروا بالألوف أو الجماعات، ورباب القبائل لاجتماعهم

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, önceki bir eşten olan çocuk ile o çocuğun bakımını üstlenen yeni eş arasındaki karşılıklı aile bağını destekler. Aynı dişil biçimin bakıcı kadın ve evde süt için beslenen hayvan anlamları da bulunduğundan bağlam ayrımı zorunludur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız tanıklanan aile ve bakım rolleriyle sınırlıdır; genel bakım veya yetiştirme eylemi bu kişi adlarına taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Önceki bir eşten olan çocuk ile o çocuğun bakımını üstlenen yeni eş arasında kurulan üvey aile ve yetiştirme ilişkisidir. Bazı kullanımlarda bakıcı kadın ya da evde beslenen dişi hayvan da aynı bakım bağıyla adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Çocuk ve yeni eş, biyolojik olmayan fakat bakım üstlenilen aile ilişkisiyle birbirine bağlanır.
Bakıcı kadın ve evde sütü için beslenen dişi hayvan, bakım ilişkisine dayanan genişlemiş kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar üvey oğul ve kız ile annenin eşi veya babanın eşini karşılıklı bakım ilişkisi içinde açıklar; bakıcı kadın anlamını da bu çerçeveye ekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çocuk ile biyolojik olmayan bakımı üstlenen eş arasındaki karşılıklı aile ilişkisini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Üvey aile rolü ile bakım üstlenme ilişkisini birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, koyulaşmış meyve özü veya yağ tortusu olan bir maddeyi ve bu maddeyle deri kap, yiyecek ya da ilacın işlenip güçlendirilmesini tutarlı biçimde bir araya getirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan koyu öz veya tortu ile onun kullanıldığı işleme alanında kalır; benzer sesli sahiplik anlamına genişlemez.

concept_map.definition: Meyveden koyulaştırılmış öz ya da yağın koyu tortusudur; ayrıca deri kap, yiyecek veya ilaç bu madde sürülerek ya da katılarak işlenip güçlendirilir.

facets.statement: Temel madde koyu bir meyve özü veya yağın dibinde kalan koyu tortudur.
Deri, kap, yiyecek ve ilaç bu maddeyle işlenir, sağlamlaştırılır veya hazırlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar koyu öz ve yağ tortusu anlamını, deri kapların güçlendirilmesi ile yiyecek ve ilaçların bu maddeyle hazırlanması kullanımına bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir yere bağlanıp oradan ayrılmama çekirdeğini insan, deve ve bulut için destekler; süreklilik ve yaklaşma anlamları da kalıcılık eksenine bağlı yan gelişmelerdir.

facets.statement: Kişi, hayvan veya başka bir varlık bulunduğu yere bağlanır ve oradan ayrılmaz.

Hayvanın eşe bağlanması ve bir şeye yaklaşma, çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, birbirine binmiş ya da aşağıda asılı duran bir bulut kümesini ortak kimlik olarak destekler. Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda belirtilse de başka tanıklıklar siyah olabileceğini söylediğinden renk tanımın zorunlu öğesi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan bulut kümesi anlamıyla sınırlıdır; yağmurun kendisi veya yalnız yağış zamanı bu yalın anlama taşınmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanıklanan yalın biçim üç ayrı sözlük anlamı taşır; tanım bunları tek anlamda birleştirmeden aynı biçimin çok anlamlı kullanımları olarak verir.

facets.statement: Kayıt, aynı biçim altında birbirine indirgenmeyen üç alternatif sözlük anlamını bir arada tanıklar.

Başka bir kullanımda çözülmesi güç, sıkıca bağlanmış düğümü bildirir.
Bir diğer kullanımda başkasına sağlanan iyilik ve yardımı bildirir.

Birinin ya da bir şeyin ötekinden daha yukarıda bulunmasına uzanır.

يدخل فيه الربا في البيع أو القرض، والزيادة على رأس المال، والربية لغة أو اسم خاص للربا.
يدخل فيه الربو بمعنى النفس العالي أو البهر أو الانبهار، وما يصيب الإنسان أو الدابة من علو النفس أو الانتفاخ من مشي أو عدو أو فزع.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, çocuk veya ürün gibi büyüyen bir varlığı besleyerek gelişmesini sağlama ile bir topluluk içinde yetişip gelişme yönlerini aynı büyüme sürecinde birleştirir. Ettirgen bakım ile yetişenin kendi gelişimi katılımcı bakımından ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Besleyip büyütme, bunun sonucu gelişme ve bir topluluk içinde yetişme kullanımları katılımcı değişimleri korunarak ayrı gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Çocuk ya da ürün gibi büyüyen bir varlığı besleyerek gelişmesini sağlamak veya bu bakımın etkisiyle büyümektir. Kişinin bir topluluğun içinde yetişip gelişmesi de bu sürecin toplumsal yönüdür.

facets.statement: Büyüyen varlık beslenir ve gelişmesi sağlanır.
Beslenen çocuk veya ürün bakımın sonucu olarak büyür.
Kişi belirli bir topluluğun içinde yetişip gelişebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar beslemeyi büyümenin nedeni, büyümeyi de bakımın sonucu olarak ilişkilendirir; çocuk ve ürün bu yapının örnekleridir, topluluk içinde yetişme ise katılımcı yönünü değiştirir.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.
